guard.note: getEntitiesOfClass(GSLScreenShakeEntity, player box +-50) and getEntitiesOfClass(GSLFollowingScreenShakeEntity, +-50) (the two wrapped calls), then the shake sum over each list; the angles change only when the sum is above 0
getEntitiesOfClass(GSLScreenFlashEntity, +-50) (the wrapped call), the strongest flash of the list, the overlay only when its alpha is above 0
getEntitiesOfClass(GSLPowerInversionEntity, +-50) (the wrapped call), the strongest effect of the list, the overlay only when its phase is not NONE
getEntitiesOfClass(class, box) = getEntitiesOfClass(class, box, NO_SPECTATORS): the class search the walk mark applies to
